dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Ah, you must be Hat Guy. I've heard Sethos talk about you recently.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: And you must be the General Mahamatra. Don't tell me you're also in the habit of convincing people to go to festivals...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: No, just had to check something at the Akademiya and thought I would stop by.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: But... I am rather curious about you.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Do you play Genius Invokation TCG?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Do you know what would happen if you did play?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: You'd beat me three times in a row... a real "hat trick."
